records.failureSummary: Implemented and exported escapeHtmlText and escapeAttributeUrl in src/render.mjs and wired them into renderPage/renderMarkdownLite. escapeHtmlText replaces &, <, >, " and ' with &, <, >, ", ' in a single regex pass (no double-escaping; input not mutated). escapeAttributeUrl escapes only attribute-breaking characters (& -> &, " -> ") and preserves /, ?, =, :, # and other URL characters verbatim; it is never applied to text and text escaping is never applied to URLs. All dynamically inserted text (title in <title> and <h1>, heading text, paragraph text, link text) goes through escapeHtmlText. Only src/render.mjs (a backend file) was changed; src/frontmatter.mjs, src/build.mjs and src/cli.mjs are untouched and API signatures/exports are preserved. Verification: helper-level assertions all pass (five-char escaping, single-pass no double-escape, URL preserves / ? = : #, URL escapes only & and ", input not mutated), the renderPage unit test passes, and npm run build plus npm run lint (node --check over all four sources) exit 0. The single remaining failing test is buildSite in test/build.test.mjs because src/build.mjs is still a stub; that belongs to the separate buildSite slice and is outside this task's scope.
